name: Gusha no Kyouben ~Ima Shika Dekinai Koto ga Takusan Arun Da!~
original_name: 愚者ノ教鞭 ～今しかできないことがたくさんあるんだ！～
source:
That summer, Kazuki and his six friends went on a crusade together. They still don’t know if it was the right thing to do, but they gave it their all. There was no theory, reason or sound judgment behind it; it was just based on their own beliefs. This is a story about innocent and reckless kids who rebelled against the ‘foolish’ adults. They strove for their own futures, unchained from this unreasonable world.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/10/29/october-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
那年夏天，一树和他的六个朋友一起去讨伐。他们仍然不知道这样做是否正确，但他们全力以赴。它背后没有任何理论、理由或合理的判断；这只是基于他们自己的信仰。这是一个关于天真鲁莽的孩子反抗“愚蠢”大人的故事。他们为自己的未来而奋斗，摆脱这个不合理的世界。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2016/10/29/october-2016-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
